# MonoSend

> MonoSend (monosend.io) is an API-first email marketing automation platform for developers, marketers, and AI agents. Build sophisticated email workflows, manage contacts and segments, create beautiful templates, and track deliverability with comprehensive analytics.

## Product Overview

MonoSend combines developer-friendly APIs with visual workflow automation:
- **Email API**: Send transactional and marketing emails with industry-leading deliverability
- **Workflow Automation**: Visual drag-and-drop email sequences with conditional logic
- **Template Builder**: React-based email templates with AI-assisted generation
- **Contact Management**: Segments, custom fields, and audience targeting
- **Analytics**: Real-time tracking for sends, opens, clicks, bounces, and complaints
- **Domain Management**: DNS verification, DKIM/SPF/DMARC configuration

## Primary Sources

- [Documentation](https://docs.monosend.io/): Complete guides, API reference, concepts, and best practices (primary source for implementation)
- [App Dashboard](https://app.monosend.io/): Access API keys, domains, templates, workflows, contacts, logs, webhooks, analytics (requires authentication)
- [Marketing Homepage](https://monosend.io/): Product overview, pricing, feature comparison, sign-up
